summary: Frontend code review verification for compensation UI layout standardization across Dirigente, Collaboratore views (user and admin). All requested UI changes verified via code review. Visual testing limited due to React Native Web login/navigation issues.

integration_issues.issue: React Native Web TouchableOpacity button and navigation does not work reliably with Playwright. Session lost on role selection click.
integration_issues.notes: Known React Native Web limitation, not a bug in the app. Same issue as iteration_28
